---
name: Web Canvas
description: Create an interactive web canvas that lets participants adjust an application design.
---

# Web Canvas

When a participant needs to explore a visual direction, create a small,
accessible local web canvas in the application workspace. Make design tokens,
layout options, content, and component states adjustable through visible
controls. Preserve the selected values in a reviewable format and summarize
the resulting design decisions.

Do not add a canvas to production code without approval. Reuse the existing
frontend stack and remove throwaway artifacts after the design is accepted.
